pipeline.operation: Receive immutable bytes, capture trusted repository commit/blob SHA, enforce external maximum document bytes, reject duplicate raw JSON keys before deserialization
Validate parsed case against separately qualified Draft 2020-12 v0.3 schema
Validate parsed policy against generic schema, and require separately trusted case-specific literal policy lock
Require exact case_id/policy_id/schema_version binding and case_id equality across case and policy; reject null or merely self-declared hash as authenticated link
Compute SHA-256 of source raw bytes under a qualified mechanism; require independent trusted digest and verify identity before promotion from UNVERIFIED
Every policy_rule_ref must match an immutable rule in the trusted case-specific policy; deny foreign, missing and duplicate policy IDs
Check policy gates against document evidence/asset claims and editorial closing statements; self-asserted licenses never clear R6
Emit separately scoped structural, rule-link, byte-check, source/history, rights, IVV and runner states; no aggregate PASS from documentary matching

invariant_requirements: An EP01 policy document MUST retain the exact immutable snapshot as the frozen lock for the pilot until an authorized signed review replaces it.
A v0.3 case with binding_status=DECLARED_NOT_VERIFIED MUST NOT be publishable or treated as RIGHTS_CLEARED, historical source authenticated, execution qualified or global IVV approved.
Policy hash is determined from raw bytes and trusted identity, not from an arbitrary JSON field; canonical JSON normalization requires a separately fixed algorithm and cannot be silently assumed.
Policy references and asset/evidence IDs are typed registries; identical spelling across different namespaces is not a cross-record validation success.
Historic opponent side may be a consultation team; a team move cannot be assigned to an individual member absent independently supported evidence.
No Policy B qualification may be inferred from a process timeout, source input-size checks, short output, streaming log truncation, repository protection or passing JSON validation.

A branch or tag name is a mutable locator, not an immutable policy identity; any review claim tied only to a named ref must remain unverified until an immutable repository object identity is captured and checked.
A Git commit or blob object ID may serve as repository provenance, but MUST NOT be substituted for the separately specified qualified raw-byte SHA-256 policy digest.

proposed_negative_cases.mutation: v0.3 case has no policy file
case points to foreign case_id in policy
case policy_id mismatches actual policy record
wrong policy schema version
untrusted field says VERIFIED while case binding remains declared
policy digest declaration is null
non-null digest declared without verified trusted source bytes
a single changed byte of the policy sidecar
unsupported canonicalization substituted without approval
EP01 R6 changed to CLEARED
EP01 E5B4D changed to PASS
publication flag set true
case references missing F03 rule
duplicated F03 in same policy
reuse EP01 policy against Morphy case
external policy URL points outside allowed trusted repository
raw JSON contains duplicated binding_status keys
rights-cleared asset status without competent license evidence
opponent consultation-team repeats a member ID
assign Morphy opponent move to one advisor without supporting evidence
propose timeline/rights as globally PASS based on structural schema
attach execution approval without qualified Policy B runner
case/policy binding keeps the same branch label while the resolved policy blob changes
Git blob or commit object ID is copied into declared_digest_sha256 and treated as qualified byte trust
